# Open Chair Advisory

> Alex Williamson's fractional practice. Alex joins early-stage companies, mostly in health tech and medical devices, and runs implementation, strategy and operations, or go-to-market until the founder or a full-time hire takes over. Booking new engagements starting February 2027. Contact: arwilliamson9@gmail.com

Recent engagements, by strength: a scheduler system rollout at VA Medical Centers and then the organizational design and operating model for a national clinical contact center network with 8,000+ staff across 170+ sites (18 regions consolidated to 5, role functions adjusted), founder GTM enablement at Dispatch Care (ICP, positioning, collateral, campaigns, conference prep, CRM; qualified meetings more than doubled), and a product launch at Kroot.
